## About
We're National Auto Glass & Mirror on Dix Hwy in Lincoln Park, and we're Michigan owned and operated. We repair and replace windshields and other auto glass on cars, trucks and heavy equipment.
Our technicians are National Glass Association certified and install your glass to factory specifications. We use DOT-certified glass, and our replacements are backed by a written lifetime nationwide warranty.
Folks keep coming back, and reviewers mention Barbara in the office by name. We're rated 4.5 from 259 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn your next one.

## Services
- Windshield repair & replacement: Chipped or cracked windshield? We repair what can be repaired and replace what can't, using OEM quality windshields.
- Free mobile auto glass service: We'll come to your home, office or school, wherever you are.
- Side window replacement: Windshields aren't all we do. One customer came to us to have a side window replaced in his car.
- Cars, trucks and heavy equipment: We work on all types of vehicles, from the family car to heavy equipment.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come to me?
A: Yes. Our mobile service is free, and we'll come to your home, office or school.

Q: How quickly can you get it done?
A: Often the same day. One customer had a side window ordered and installed the same day.

Q: When is the Lincoln Park shop open?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and closed Sunday.
